name: acme-handbook
description: Questions answerable from DocRAG's samples/acme-handbook.md. Ingest that file into the RAG API before running.

testCases.question: How many unused vacation days can I carry over into the next year?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Up to 5 unused vacation days carry over into the next calendar year; anything above that expires on January 31.

expectedSources.chunkContains: carry over into the next calendar year

testCases.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get per year?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 vacation days per month, which is 18 days per year.

testCases.question: When do vacation days above the carryover limit expire?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Days above the carryover limit of 5 expire on January 31.

testCases.question: I have worked full-time for six months. How many vacation days have I accrued?
testCases.expectedAnswer: 9 days, because full-time employees accrue 1.5 vacation days per month (1.5 x 6).

testCases.question: How many paid sick days do employees get each year?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year.

testCases.question: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
testCases.expectedAnswer: A doctor's note is required for absences longer than three consecutive days.

testCases.question: How many days per week can I work remotely?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Up to three days per week, with manager approval.

expectedSources.chunkContains: up to three days per week

testCases.question: How much does the company reimburse for home internet?
How do I get a monitor for working from home, and what is the budget?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Request equipment such as monitors through the IT portal; there is a one-time budget of $400.

testCases.question: How long do I have to submit an expense report?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Within 30 days of purchase, using the finance portal.

testCases.question: Do I need a receipt for a $40 expense?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Yes. Receipts are required for any expense over $25.

testCases.question: What class must I book for a four-hour flight?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Economy class, which is required for flights under six hours, booked through the approved travel agency.
